text:
sara: deploy-bot blocked the 03/21 release — preflight found an env-parity mismatch in model routing config, holding the rollout until we decide.
deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK FAILED: variant_override_missing (service=ModelRoutingService, check=model.override.key)
mike: looking into it. quick diff shows staging has a top-level key `model_variant_overrides` while prod nests it under `deployment.features.model_overrides`
mike: example:
```yaml
# staging
model_variant_overrides:
  /api/infer: model_v2_quant

# prod
deployment:
  features:
    model_overrides:
      /api/infer: model_v2_quant
```
kevin: what's the customer impact if we proceed? latency or wrong model returned?
lisa: prod traffic is falling back to the small base model for some routes — we see increased 95th pct latency and a handful of inference checksum mismatches in logs (KV cache keys differ because variant key not present)
lisa: logs:
```
E inference: cache_key_mismatch service=ModelCache route=/api/infer expected=... got=... variant=default
W routing: fallback_to_small_model service=ModelRoutingService route=/api/infer
```
julie: we can do a quick compatibility shim that reads both paths and writes the top-level key on startup. low-risk patch, single-file change, no model container rebuild.
mike: options: A) rollback the release (lose latest changes) B) apply shim hotfix + backfill prod keys C) pause until next change window. Which do we pick?
sara: minimize customer impact — prefer B. hotfix + backfill, then smoke canary for 30m. change window until 23:59 PT if needed.
kevin: +1 for B. I'll run targeted smoke tests (latency + correctness) after backfill.
lisa: I'll prepare a backfill script to populate `model_variant_overrides` from `deployment.features.model_overrides` for all affected namespaces. planning to run in 10m with a dry-run first.
julie: I'll open a small PR with the shim and a single-line config migration. request review: @mike @lisa
mike: reviewing now. if green, merge and deploy to canary-only first.
deploy-bot: RELEASE HOLD LIFTED PENDING: canary_deploy_pass (will auto-unblock after canary passes)
sara: update release notes: add bullet under 'known fixes' — env parity: model routing key normalization; added shim + migration; will add integration test to preflight to avoid regression. assign follow-ups to infra and platform.
kevin: running canary smoke now. will report back in ~20m.
lisa: dry-run backfill shows 14 namespaces would be updated, no surprises. executing in 5.
mike: merged shim PR and triggered canary deploy. watching.
kevin: canary looks good so far — latency within baseline and no checksum mismatches. proceeding to roll forward unless objections.
sara: roll forward after one more verification cycle. thanks team :thumbsup:
